April 23, 2018 - By Peter Erickson 
Barclays Plc increased its stake in Plantronics Inc New (PLT) by 152.07% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Barclays Plc bought 19,320 shares as the company’s stock rose 7.06% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 32,025 shares of the public utilities company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.61M, up from 12,705 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Barclays Plc who had been investing in Plantronics Inc New for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $2.09 billion market cap company. It closed at $64.97 lastly.
